acceptance_predicates.description: The development manifest contains versioned channel, source repository/ref, source commit/tree, build identity, and development provenance fields.
The dev materializer binds the manifest to the exact current ASB/TUI source heads used for the build.
Malformed, tampered, digest-mismatched, stale, mutable, or unsupported-channel manifests fail with typed diagnostics.
Generated authenticity material and missing development authentication remain diagnostics and never block the dev prototype.
Manifest validation and receipts contain no credentials, raw provider responses, or private host paths.

definition_of_done: Exact current-head manifest and compatibility fixtures pass for valid, stale, tampered, mutable, and future-channel inputs.
Independent review and hosted checks pass with no secret-shaped output.

inputs.description: A bounded development-channel materialization from the exact selected source head.
Valid, stale, tampered, digest-mismatched, mutable, and unavailable-channel fixtures.

outputs.description: Typed development manifest and privacy-safe validation diagnostics bound to the exact source/build identity.

gates.description: The manifest source and build identities match the exact tested current heads.
Tamper, stale, mutable, and unsupported inputs fail closed without turning absent development keys into a blocker.
